tools.name: smartdoctor_list_appointments
tools.description: List the clinic's appointments from a start date (default today), optionally for one patient or one status. Uses GET /integracao/agendas/listar.

tools.name: smartdoctor_get_appointment
tools.description: Get one appointment by id: date, time, status, specialty, doctor, unit, price and patient. Uses GET /integracao/agendas/{id}.

tools.name: smartdoctor_check_appointment_conflict
tools.description: Check whether the patient already has an appointment on that date for that specialty, to avoid a double booking. An empty list means no conflict. Uses GET /integracao/agendas/verificar.

tools.name: smartdoctor_list_free_slots
tools.description: List the free time slots per doctor for one specialty, before a time is offered to a patient. Read-only, sent as a POST. Uses POST /integracao/controle-agendas/horarios-disponiveis.

tools.name: smartdoctor_find_patient_by_cpf
tools.description: Check whether a CPF is already a patient of the clinic, and get the contact details. The answer has encontrado (true or false); when false, the patient is not registered. Uses GET /integracao/pacientes/cpf.

tools.name: smartdoctor_list_prices
tools.description: List the clinic's active specialties and their prices (convenio PARTICULAR and others). Uses GET /integracao/consultas-valor.

tools.name: smartdoctor_create_appointment
tools.description: Book a consultation for a patient. Without a time, the first free time of the day is used. For a new patient (CPF not yet registered), patient_name, patient_phone and patient_birth_date are all required. The specialty needs a PARTICULAR price and a schedule on that date. Uses POST /integracao/agenda

tools.name: smartdoctor_reschedule_appointment
tools.description: Move an existing appointment to a new date and time. The new time must be free. Uses PUT /integracao/agendas with the appointment id.

tools.name: smartdoctor_cancel_appointment
tools.description: Cancel an appointment by id (status becomes CANCELADO). The appointment is kept in the clinic's records. Uses PUT /integracao/agendas.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: smartdoctor_list_free_slots · Private data: smartdoctor_find_patient_by_cpf, smartdoctor_cancel_appointment · Public sink: smartdoctor_list_free_slots, smartdoctor_create_appointment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: smartdoctor_list_free_slots · Private data: smartdoctor_find_patient_by_cpf, smartdoctor_cancel_appointment · Public sink: smartdoctor_list_free_slots, smartdoctor_create_appointment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
